name: Aho Corasick - Application
statement:
Given an integer n indicating the number of patterns.Then follow n lines, each containing non empty strings, representing patterns.
Then comes a non empty string representing text.
Output n lines where ith line contains the positions of all occurances of the ith pattern in text.
inputFormat:
First line: n
Then follow n lines, each containing non empty strings, representing patterns.
Next line consists of a string, text
outputFormat: Print n lines each consisting of occurrences of ith pattern's start index , print -1 if ith pattern doesnt occur
sampleInput:
6
ACC
ATC
CAT
GCG
C
T
GCATCG
